# Hwanmoo Yong, Ph.D. (용환무)

> CEO of Moomoo Company and CTO of Funeasy, with a Yonsei Ph.D. Builds apps and backends (10+ years) and now LLM automation. Researches deep RL and neural networks.

## Profile

- Now: CEO, Moomoo Company (2025–)
- Now: CTO, Funeasy (2023–)
- Education: Ph.D., M.S. and B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Yonsei University
- Teaching: Lecturer in Mechanical Engineering, Yonsei University (2022–23). Graduate course: Optimal Control and Reinforcement Learning
- Based in: Seoul, South Korea

## Expertise

- Development: iOS/Android apps, large-scale backends, LLM automation, low-latency Rust systems
- Research: Deep reinforcement learning, neural networks, vehicle dynamics and control, state estimation

## Development projects

10+ years building production software · 20+ software projects delivered

- [Multilingual email automation on a private LLM for a freight forwarder](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/freight-mail-automation/): 2026 · Sole engineer, end to end · Cuts outgoing email work by an estimated 30–47%
- [Campaign settlement platform](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/campaign-settlement/): 2026–now · Participant app, customer portal and admin tool on one settlement engine
- [Campaign distribution and settlement hub](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/campaign-distribution-hub/): 2026–now · Routes campaign volume to multiple partner channels and settles it automatically
- [Rust systems for high-frequency trading on Solana](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/solana-transaction-infra/): 2025 · Millisecond transaction relay, deployed on mainnet across multiple overseas regions
- [Company-wide ERP for a music rights firm](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/music-royalty-erp/): 2023–now · Sole engineer, end to end · Automated royalty statements and settlement
- [Mobile rewards app and platform](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/rewards-platform/): 2023–now · iOS/Android app, backend and back office · Ledger of hundreds of millions of transactions
- [Cardiac imaging AI service](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/cardiac-imaging-ai/): 2023 · Sole developer · Built the AI analysis server, app and website
- [Referral and patient-record services for a major hospital's research team](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/hospital-clinical-services/): 2021–25 · Sole developer · Mobile apps, web apps and servers, with medical-device integration
- [Repeat-purchase commerce app and platform](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/reorder-commerce/): 2020–23 · Co-founder · app and backend development · Built everything, from the iOS/Android app to payments and delivery tracking
- [Paid membership platform](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/paid-membership-platform/): 2020–21 · From payments and automated messaging to retention and revenue analytics
- [Custom-fit ordering with AI sizing from phone video](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/ai-sizing-custom-orders/): 2020–21
- [Back office and in-house commerce platform for an eyewear store network](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/eyewear-retail-platform/): 2018–20 · From customer requests to settlement, across hundreds of stores
- [Corporate travel management platform](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/corporate-travel-platform/): 2017–18 · Integrated with global airline reservation systems
- Multi-party scheduling app: 2015–17
- Student and grade management system for after-school academies: 2014–16

## Research projects

6 industry and government R&D projects

- [AI test driver for next-generation steering systems](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/steering-ai-test-driver/): 2023–24 · with an auto parts maker · technical lead · Deep RL drivers handle limit maneuvers reliably in simulation; delivered to the client
- [Unsupervised clustering of ocean sensor data](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/ocean-sensor-clustering/): 2023 · Research contract
- [Neural-network vehicle state estimation from low-cost sensors](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/vehicle-state-estimation/): 2021 · A recurrent neural network recovers speed and displacement from inertial sensors alone
- [Semi-active suspension control with deep reinforcement learning](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/learned-suspension/): 2019–20 · with an automaker · Controller trained and road-tested on a real car
- [Computing a production line's operating rules as an optimal policy](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/manufacturing-rule-synthesis/): 2019–20 · with a manufacturing-equipment company · Verified running on a real controller
- [Customer-aware AI attendant robot for VR simulators](https://hwanmoo.yong.phd/work/vr-attendant-robot/): 2017–18 · Government R&D · Field-tested with hundreds of visitors; the robot significantly raised satisfaction
